normative_scope: Core stationary-QPP benchmark. This document freezes the synthetic generator, condition grid, RNG, pairing, estimands and future AFINO execution plan before any synthetic light curve is generated.

ground_truth.NULL_FLARE_RED_NOISE: Unit baseline plus the frozen asymmetric flare envelope and one Gaussian Fourier-synthesis noise realization; no periodic component.
ground_truth.STATIONARY_QPP_PRESENT: The same baseline, flare, noise and phase block, with one sinusoid of fixed frequency whose amplitude is multiplied by the flare envelope.
ground_truth.interpretation_limit: Synthetic ground truth is known by construction and must not be described as observational or physical ground truth.

module_exclusions: additional damping beyond multiplication by the flare envelope

generator.floating_point_expectation: IEEE-754 float64 in the future implementation

qpp.positive_flux_definition: F_QPP(t) = 1 + E(t) + qpp_fraction * E(t) * sin(2*pi*(t-t_peak)/period_s + phi) + epsilon_alpha(t)

noise.nyquist_component: for even N, replace the final complex draw by one additional real normal draw before inverse FFT
noise.standardization: subtract the sample mean; divide by sample standard deviation with ddof=1; multiply by noise_std
noise.no_redraw_rule: A non-finite or zero-standard-deviation realization is recorded as a generation failure and is never replaced by another seed.

draw_order: if N is even, draw one extra real Nyquist normal
draw one uniform phase from the independent phase generator
rng_and_pairing.reuse_rule: For a fixed (N, alpha, data_seed), reuse exactly the same noise array and the same phi for the null, every admitted period and all three qpp_fraction values.
rng_and_pairing.repeated_measures_statement: Series that differ only in ground truth, period or qpp_fraction within the same block are repeated measures and must not be treated as independent realizations.

design_grid.ordering_rule: First 12 null conditions ordered by N then alpha; then 99 positive conditions ordered by N, period, alpha and qpp_fraction.

validity_definitions.valid_model_call: The requested model call completes and returns finite log-likelihood and finite BIC; M1 period diagnostics additionally require a finite formal M1 center.
validity_definitions.valid_primary_decision: M0, M1 and M2 are all valid for the same series and optimizer seed, so the frozen double-BIC rule can be evaluated.
validity_definitions.failed_calls: Failures remain in the denominator of valid_run_rate and are never imputed as selected or not selected.

primary_condition_level.valid_run_rate: number of valid primary decisions / 40 planned data seeds
primary_condition_level.selection_rate: number of selected valid primary decisions / number of valid primary decisions; undefined when there are zero valid decisions
primary_condition_level.mandatory_joint_reporting: selection_rate and valid_run_rate must always be shown together

period.prohibited_language: The M1 center of a non-selected run must not be called a recovered period.

optimizer_stability.audit_unit: data_seed=0 within each of the 111 conditions, evaluated at external optimizer seeds 0 through 9
optimizer_stability.optimizer_seed_decision_discordance: For n_valid >= 2, the proportion of unordered pairs of valid optimizer seeds with different binary decisions: 2*n_selected*n_not_selected/(n_valid*(n_valid-1)); otherwise null.
optimizer_stability.optimizer_seed_instability_flag: true when at least one valid selected and one valid non-selected decision occur among the ten seeds
optimizer_stability.M2_multiple_solution_flag: true when at least two finite M2 BIC values exist and M2_BIC_range > 0.001
optimizer_stability.bound_hit_rate_by_model: model calls with at least one tracked parameter at a bound / valid calls for that model
optimizer_stability.warning_rate_by_model: attempted model calls emitting at least one warning / attempted model calls for that model
optimizer_stability.numerical_failure_rate: failed model calls / attempted model calls, reported overall and separately by model

paired_comparisons.rule: Any contrast across null/positive, amplitude or period must be computed within the shared (N, alpha, data_seed) block before aggregation.
paired_comparisons.independence_prohibition: Do not use analyses that count amplitude or period variants sharing a noise block as independent noise realizations.

prohibited_reinterpretations: Do not call a synthetic selection rate observational sensitivity.
Do not call a null selection rate an observational false-positive rate.
Do not add a success threshold after results are visible.
Do not alter amplitudes, periods, slopes or sample sizes after results.

structural_checks_required_before_full_e: null period_s, qpp_fraction and minimum_cycles are empty
all positive minimum_cycles are at least 3
480 null, 3960 positive and 4440 total planned series
13320 primary and 2997 additional stability model calls
all condition identifiers are unique and ordered deterministically
paired noise and phase hashes match wherever reuse is required
no curve is silently regenerated after a generation failure

generator_risks.description: At small N, the realized spectrum can differ strongly from the nominal f^-alpha shape.
Every noise realization is forced to the same sample standard deviation, removing between-realization variance in total noise power.
alpha=2 can concentrate substantial power in the lowest available Fourier bins, especially in short windows.
Rise and decay times are fractions of duration, so changing N changes both window length and absolute flare timescales.
Frequency is stationary, but amplitude varies with E(t); this module tests no additional damping beyond that modulation.
Conditions sharing a noise/phase block are correlated repeated measures and require paired interpretation.
N=15 and other short configurations may provide very few bins to distinguish M1 from M0 and M2.
Exact bitwise reproduction requires the frozen PCG64 draw order and a recorded NumPy environment in F1.2.

versioning_rule.substantive_change_action: Create a new preregistration version and new artifact hashes; never overwrite version 1.0.0.
versioning_rule.typographical_change_action: Issue a separate erratum linked to this hash when execution behavior and interpretation are unchanged.
